name: oregon-prosperity-council-doctree
description: Progressive-disclosure web index for the Oregon Prosperity Council Report (June 2026), built for agent navigation.

scripts.tree:build: node scripts/build-outline.mjs && node "$DOCTREE_SKILL/scripts/run.mjs" plan --project-root . && node scripts/normalize-plan.mjs && node "$DOCTREE_SKILL/scripts/run.mjs" emit --project-root .
scripts.tree:enrich: node "$DOCTREE_SKILL/scripts/run.mjs" enrich --project-root . && node "$DOCTREE_SKILL/scripts/run.mjs" merge --project-root . && node "$DOCTREE_SKILL/scripts/run.mjs" rollup --project-root .
